msgs.text: Genera 5 imágenes separadas con Nano Banana 2.1, cada una en su formato y con su referencia (las referencias están adjuntas). Usa los textos tal cual, sin reescribirlos ni añadir nada. REGLA A: Use the EXACT garment(s) and accessories from the reference image: identical cut, length, fabric, colour, print, buttons, trims and details. Do not redesign, recolour or add garments. Show the clothes on a professional female fashion model (a woman). If the reference is a mirror selfie, the new photo has no phone, no mirror and no selfie pose. Photorealistic, high-end commercial photography, natural skin texture, crisp material detail, no text, no letters, no watermark, no logos, no brand names, no frames, no collage, no words or labels anywhere in the image. IMAGEN 1 «h» (formato 16:9, referencia nama-06.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): A stylish Spanish woman in her thirties wearing a cream tapestry jacket with a red and green floral pattern over a white shirt with blue jeans from the reference, walking at a sunny street in the old town of Jerez de la Frontera, Cádiz, Spain, with whitewashed walls and orange trees, golden hour. One single continuous photograph, never a split screen, diptych, panel or collage. The subject stands in the right third of the frame and the same scene continues to the left, softly out of focus and calm, with room for a headline. Wide editorial campaign image, cinematic natural light. IMAGEN 2 «p1» (formato 3:4, referencia nama-09.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): E-commerce product photo for a fashion boutique: a model wearing a colourful embroidered patchwork jacket with a large cream faux-fur collar from the reference, standing naturally, framed from just above the lips (face cropped at the mouth) down to the shoes so the whole outfit is visible, centred, on a seamless warm light (#ECE7E0) studio background with a soft natural floor shadow, soft diffused daylight from the left. IMAGEN 3 «p2» (formato 3:4, referencia nama-12.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): E-commerce product photo for a fashion boutique: a model wearing a burgundy quilted jacket with a blue and cream floral print from the reference, standing naturally, framed from just above the lips (face cropped at the mouth) down to the shoes so the whole outfit is visible, centred, on a seamless warm light (#ECE7E0) studio background with a soft natural floor shadow, soft diffused daylight from the left. IMAGEN 4 «p3» (formato 3:4, referencia nama-20.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): E-commerce product photo for a fashion boutique: a model wearing a lilac long-sleeve wrap midi dress with a belt from the reference, standing naturally, framed from just above the lips (face cropped at the mouth) down to the shoes so the whole outfit is visible, centred, on a seamless warm light (#ECE7E0) studio background with a soft natural floor shadow, soft diffused daylight from the left. IMAGEN 5 «p4» (formato 3:4, sin referencia, aplica la REGLA A): E-commerce product photo for a fashion boutique: a model wearing a mustard yellow chunky knit cardigan with small embroidered flowers over a white blouse with light blue jeans from the reference, standing naturally, framed from just above the lips (face cropped at the mouth) down to the shoes so the whole outfit is visible, centred, on a seamless warm light (#ECE7E0) studio background with a soft natural floor shadow, soft diffused daylight from the left.
